title: STORY COLLECTION: AN OBSCURE WANDERER OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: AN OBSCURE WANDERER
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Standard-Issue Components, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: An Obscure Wanderer event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Standard-Issue Components by clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Silver Salt Supermarket Chain. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
[SILVER SALT SUPERMARKET CHAIN] DURATION: March 31, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - April 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[SILVER SALT SUPERMARKET CHAIN] MAIN REWARDS: EPOQUE Collection - Disguise for Utage, Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Special Operation. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Special Operation.
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Never Vowed], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting [Never Vowed], and will be permanently added to other Headhuntings in future update.
Operator Młynar and Proviso will gain more trust during this event.
04 [ENCOUNTER AT THE OSMANTHUS BLOSSOM] LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN

DETAILS: During the event, you can participate in Crust Dough Kneading, Filling Mixing, Mooncake Baking in the first 3 log-ins to make Mooncakes, get the corresponding style of Mooncakes (use to get Sanity * 120) and the event exclusive furniture. Log in for 7 days to receive Orundum, Module Materials, Battle Records, and more.
Day 1(Crust Dough Kneading): Data Supplement Stick * 10, Tactical Battle Record * 25
Day 3 (Mooncake Baking): Exclusive Furniture * 1, Mooncake (use to get Sanity * 120)
Day 6: Module Data Block * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Mooncake from this event.
During this Mooncake-Making event, you cannot obtain mooncakes and furniture that you did not select.
05 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- EPOQUE Collection - Book Reader for Mountain
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Dzwonek Campsite, will be available at the Store for a limited time.
07 CHIP PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Guard Chip Pack * 8, Guard Chip * 5, LMD * 210000
DETAILS: The Record Restoration of Beyond Here will be open after the next update. The limited event rewards will be permanently available for players to unlock.
